title: No stop can reach a detached tool whose runner was already reaped
description:
interruptToolGroups and interruptDetachedTools find tools as descendants of a runner pid. A runner that exited and was reaped leaves its still-running detached tools orphaned (ppid 1) with nothing to walk, so a later cancel cannot kill them even though they keep the runner's lock held and the attempt reads alive. This is the documented limitation in stopProven's comment (lock.go:230) generalized to detached tools; covering it needs a different naming (an fd-to-pid mapping or recording tool pids at spawn).
evidence: internal/exec/subprocess/lock.go:230 (the stopProven comment names the case it cannot cover); internal/exec/subprocess/interrupt.go descendantsOf walks by ppid only
